user-stories.text: The client receives independently signed commitments and data with witnesses from a ledger provider. An optional application builder interprets historical transactions and supplies application proofs. The client checks both levels of evidence.

current-state.text: Lockness is in design. The record distinguishes proposed behavior from unproved contracts. No production service, accepted formal model or institutional publisher is claimed.

why-terminals-should-consume-anchored-da.text: Lockness gives terminals a checkable basis for action. They verify provider data against independently accepted roots before building transactions or driving real-world effects. Data providers can be replaced without surrendering trust policy. Proofs establish specified claims; completeness, freshness and action authorization remain separate requirements.
